Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

package Problems_On_Number;

import java.util.Scanner;

public class GreatestOfThree {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        System.out.println("enter the first number:");
        int num1 = sc.nextInt();
        System.out.println("enter the Second number:");
        int num2 = sc.nextInt();
        System.out.println("enter the Third number:");
        int num3 = sc.nextInt();
        int max = Math.max(num1, Math.max(num2, num3));
        System.out.println("the maximum value is " + max);
        sc.close();
    }

}
